components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (for example MR, MRS, MS
            or DR). When supplied it is stored and returned, and drives the derived
            salutation.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when structured address fields (addressLine1) are
            supplied they are preferred. On read this is the composed, normalized
            address: the normalized addressLine1 with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present, or the
            normalized flat address when only the flat form was supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address (street
            number and name). Optional; preferred over the flat 'address' when a
            non-blank value is supplied. Normalized on create (trimmed, internal
            whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded) and
            returned in that normalized form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (unit or suite). Normalized on create like addressLine1 and, when
            present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and this E.164 value is stored and
            returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is normalized to lower case before being
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            supplied. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed
            table keyed by the city's region (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne ->
            VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range postcode is rejected with
            400. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional; when supplied it is stored and returned, and drives the
            derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only flag acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household with an existing owner. A household is keyed on (lastName,
            postcode), so a create whose lastName and postcode already belong to
            another owner (the lastName compared case-insensitively with collapsed
            whitespace) is rejected with 409 when this flag is omitted or false; when
            true the create bypasses that duplicate block and the owner is created as
            a declared household member (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate).
            The householdId is assigned deterministically regardless of this flag; the
            flag is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URI of this owner resource, formatted '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived from the optional title and the
                stored last name: the title, a single space and the last name when a
                title is present (for example 'DR who'), or just the last name when no
                title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored
                first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the stored
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for human reading: the country
                calling code (kept with its leading '+'), a space, then the national
                digits grouped in threes from the left, separated by spaces. The raw
                'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number
                of owners at the time this owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 8
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by the owners of a single household. It is
                derived deterministically from the owner's normalized lastName and
                postcode (the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode), so owners sharing a lastName and
                postcode automatically resolve to the same identifier. It is absent for
                an owner created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners who already existed, at the time this owner was
                created, sharing this owner's firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). It is zero when no earlier owner shared both names.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits
                of the fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July) that the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate falls in.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year (which starts on 1 July) that the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate falls in. A registration date on
                or after 1 July belongs to the fiscal year ending in the following
                calendar year (for example 2026-08-10 yields 'FY27').
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, a non-negative score. It starts at 0 and
                accumulates: 2 points when an email address is present, 1 point when the owner
                has no namesakes (namesakeCount is zero), 2 points for a household of 3 or more
                members (householdMemberCount is at least 3), and 3 points for tenure (the
                number of elapsed fiscal years, the fiscal year starting on 1 July, from
                registrationDate to today) of more than 1.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3 points, level 3 for
                4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) derived from the stored city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD).
                It is 'UNKNOWN' for any city not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name derived from the locality (region) using a
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent for any
                region not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created for today's
                registration date at the time of this response, signalling that the
                daily create volume is approaching the per-day limit; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners at the
                time of this response (approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50);
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate computed against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate is present.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value used to detect duplicate owners: the lower-case
                SHA-256 hex digest over the owner's normalized telephone, lower-cased email
                (empty when none) and the Soundex code of its last name, joined by '|'. Two
                owners are duplicates only when their whole identity key is identical, so
                owners with the same last name and postcode but different telephones have
                different keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855c'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing an
                existing owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone; otherwise
                false. When true, 'possibleDuplicateOf' identifies the matching owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches - one sharing this
                owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone. Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining the record. Owners
                flagged deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
          required:
